name: read-budget
description: Stops Claude from re-reading the same large, unchanged file in full again and again in one session: past a limit it is pointed to Grep or a ranged Read instead.

minKb.title: Large file (KB)
minKb.description: Only files at least this big count. Smaller files are always read.

maxFullReads.title: Full reads allowed per file
maxFullReads.description: Full reads of one unchanged large file allowed before the next one is refused. The count starts over when the file changes, after a compaction and after /clear.
